annotations.title: Change an app user's role or switch them off

description: Change what an existing user of an app may do, or switch them off or back on. Takes the userId from list_app_users and at least one of role and isActive. It also puts on the app's access list a user who is not on it yet (hasAccessRow false in list_app_users), which is what an endpoint in row-level security mode "shared" checks: use it for someone who already signed in and is refused with 403. isActive false switches the user off in every mode: their calls are refused until it is set back to true; nothing of theirs is deleted. For a person who has not signed in yet there is no userId: use add_app_user with their phone. Requires organization owner or admin (an editor gets 403).

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

isActive.description: false switches the user off, true switches them back on. Omit to keep the current state

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

role.description: App-level access role: editor (reads and writes), viewer (reads), submitter (creates). Omit to keep the current one

userId.description: The user's id (userId from list_app_users), a UUID; not their externalId

name: set_app_user_role
